_comment: COMMITTED SNAPSHOT of the live Postgres catalog (public schema). Facts only: what EXISTS, which DB-internal references are broken, which functions can make outbound HTTP calls, and what is scheduled inside the database. It records NO judgement about whether an object is wired — that is computed by F24 against the repo, so the snapshot and the rule cannot drift into disagreeing. Regenerate with db-catalog-refresh.sql (read-only, pg_catalog + pg_get_*def only; no data read, no write, no cost) and commit the diff.

_netCallersComment: Functions whose body calls net.http_* (pg_net). Database-originated egress is invisible to F15 (spend chokepoint) and F16 (transport hold) because it never passes through application code — so it is recorded here and gated by F24 against an explicit sanctioned list.
